question: In 2000-01, NABARD instituted Micro Finance Development Fund with a corpus of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹100 crores**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **₹100 crores** was the initial corpus amount instituted by NABARD for the Micro Finance Development Fund in 2000-01.
 
• The Micro Finance Development Fund was established to support and promote the microfinance sector in India.
 
• The fund aims to provide financial services to the underprivileged sections of society, particularly in rural areas.
 
• NABARD, or the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development, is the apex development bank in India with a focus on the rural sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NABARD** was established on 12 July 1982 to implement the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development Act 1981.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the development of the agriculture sector, cottage and village industries, and other rural crafts.
 
• NABARD also provides refinance support for building rural infrastructure and aims to bring about rural prosperity.
 
• The institution has been instrumental in promoting sustainable and equitable agriculture and rural development through participative financial and non-financial interventions, innovations, technology, and institutional development.
